title: A prerecorded executive meeting authorizes payments
mechanism_summary: An official case account describes a deepfake group meeting with an apparent finance executive. The prerecorded meeting provided no real interaction, and payment instructions continued through messages.
suggested_beats: An employee joins an apparent executive meeting.
Confidential transfer instructions follow.
Verify the instruction through an established channel.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone authorized to move company funds
why_it_works: A staged meeting can make one fraudulent instruction appear institutionally approved.

title: A face swap supports a fraudulent loan application
mechanism_summary: An official account describes suspects using stolen identities and AI face swapping in online loan applications. The altered face helped impersonate another applicant.
suggested_beats: An online application uses someone else's identity.
A fabricated face supports the application.
Check identity using independent evidence.
why_it_works: A plausible face can falsely appear to corroborate stolen identity details.

title: A fabricated government conference leads to a transfer
mechanism_summary: Police describe a video meeting impersonating senior officials with deepfake elements. A supposed lawyer subsequently contacted the attendee to request money.
suggested_beats: An invitation offers access to officials.
A lawyer persona follows with payment instructions.
Verify the meeting and payment independently.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone invited to an apparent official meeting
why_it_works: A staged display of authority makes the later request seem endorsed.

title: A synthetic official promotes a false complaint website
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes AI videos impersonating a senior law-enforcement figure. Viewers are directed to a spoofed complaint form that collects personal details.
suggested_beats: An apparent official invites scam reports.
The linked form gathers sensitive information.
Reach the real agency through its official site.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone trying to report an earlier scam
why_it_works: A help-seeking moment makes borrowed official credibility especially persuasive.

title: A convincing private video is treated as proof of identity
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes criminals using fabricated videos in private communications to appear real. The synthetic appearance supports an otherwise unverified online identity.
suggested_beats: An online contact offers a reassuring video.
The video is treated as identity proof.
Verify the person beyond the video.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone verifying an unfamiliar online contact
why_it_works: Seeing a lifelike person can create misplaced certainty.

title: A doctor's likeness sells an unverified health product
mechanism_summary: Consumer-protection reporting describes deepfake advertisements that borrow respected doctors' likenesses. Fabricated endorsements are used to sell health products the doctors did not promote.
suggested_beats: A familiar medical figure appears in an advertisement.
The apparent endorsement urges a purchase.
Verify the endorsement through the professional's own channels.
why_it_works: Borrowed medical credibility can make an unsupported sales claim persuasive.

title: A synthetic athlete endorses a fraudulent token
mechanism_summary: Police warn of fraudulent sports-themed cryptocurrency promotions. Some use AI deepfakes of athletes or celebrities to make the platforms appear credible.
suggested_beats: A sports figure appears to endorse a token.
A linked platform solicits participation.
Verify official affiliation independently.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone drawn to sports-themed digital assets
why_it_works: Familiar sporting figures can lend false credibility to a financial promotion.

title: A deepfake dating identity leads to a false investment platform
mechanism_summary: An official account describes a syndicate using deepfakes in online dating. The relationships were used to direct people to fraudulent cryptocurrency platforms.
suggested_beats: An apparent romantic contact develops trust.
The contact recommends an investment platform.
Verify identity and the platform separately.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone trusting an online romantic introduction
why_it_works: A convincing persona can transfer relationship trust to a financial scheme.
